earlier_scan.source_named: Glottolog refs for Buna (bvn) are wordlists/surveys only (Laycock checklists, Sanders & Sanders 1980 Marienberg survey); no grammar or phonology exists.

sources.note: Morphology stub only (four noun classes, concord examples cited to Foley 2018); nothing on phonology or stress.
